filters.note: Pre-Gate-1, the menu filters do not exist as a menu (U3.2 builds it). J2 measures the CURRENT popover-based narrowing for locked pills and reports menu filters as BLOCKED until U3.2 lands. Categories is a full-screen surface, not a list filter.

assertions: switcher hides on scroll-down per G1 fix (state assertion, not timing)
journeys.steps: Open inbox, scroll fling-style through 100 rows or 10s, whichever is longer
journeys.title: Inbox list load + scroll

journeys.steps: For each pill + menu filter: apply, observe, clear
journeys.title: Each filter

assertions: honesty line present on filtered empties
metrics: filter-switch timings apply (must also paint fast)
journeys.steps: For each filter with zero results + unfiltered zero state: apply, observe
journeys.title: Each empty state

journeys.steps: Tap row, thread view, back to list
journeys.title: Thread open (+ back)

assertions: close MUST animate: intermediate transforms observed, not a vanish (G10)
journeys.title: Drawer open/close

assertions: indicator moves via transform + opacity ONLY
list offsetTop unchanged during pull (geometric no-push check)
journeys.steps: Pull inbox list past threshold, release; repeat on thread history where available
journeys.title: Pull-to-refresh

drawerPanel.note: AppShell owns the Quanty drawer and the mobile drawer (AppShell.tsx); neither exposes a stable selector on origin/main. J5 is BLOCKED on the real app until confirmed; the fixture provides [data-testid='drawer-panel'].

emptyState.match: Filtered empty: honesty line + action pair (server search + Clear filter, U4.1). Unfiltered empty: celebration copy + mascot hero.
emptyState.note: Copy/art are Gate 1 D3 decisions. J3 asserts presence of the U4.1/U4.2 structure, not specific words, until D3 signs copy.

lensTabs.match: Tab whose trimmed textContent equals the filter label (All / Unread / Drafts / Contacts / Spam).

listRows.note: Scoped to inside the resolved list container by the classifier. li-only so skeleton placeholder divs never count as rows.

listScrollContainer.resolution: First candidate whose scrollHeight exceeds clientHeight. The tabpanel is the real scroll container (overflow-y: auto, page.tsx ~3914) and carries the PTR touch handlers.

ptrIndicator.codeRef: apps/quantmail/src/app/page.tsx:3866-3889 (indicator bar; animates height today = G6)
ptrIndicator.match: Element whose text contains 'Pull down to refresh', 'Release to refresh', or 'Refreshing'

selectors.skeletonNote: Plus aria-busy=true on any element in the container. The real app renders 'six skeletons' in the windowed list (page.tsx:1515); their exact class is unconfirmed, so the classifier tries patterns + aria-busy and fail-closes to 'blank' when neither matches.

threadView.note: ConversationalThreadView has no stable test id on origin/main. J4 is BLOCKED on the real app until a live-DOM selector is confirmed; the fixture provides [data-testid='thread-view'].

status: Selectors marked 'code-confirmed' were verified against origin/main e91cd548 source (apps/quantmail/src/app/page.tsx and siblings). Selectors marked 'provisional' MUST be confirmed against a running build's live DOM before their journey counts as run — an unconfirmed selector reports the journey as BLOCKED, never silently skipped (design §6).
